tags.ImageDescription: sRGB (IEC 61966-2-1): BT.709-6 primaries, D65 white point, sRGB transfer curve. For viewing. White balance: as-shot per-channel gains, green = 1, applied AFTER black subtraction and normalisation by (white - black), and AFTER the noise model, which is calibrated in raw DN before any gain. Tone rendering: black 0.020049, white 1.165917 (linear, luminance percentiles 0.1/99.9 with white mapped to 0.9), black fraction removed 0.85, display-space contrast 0.550. Placement is a single luminance-derived gain applied to all three channels, so chromaticity is preserved; the toe is soft, so no channel is clamped to zero.

method: sRGB16 to8 by rounded /257 then Lanczos thumbnail; no color/tonal adjustment; labelled overview
